title: Crank a hose reel with one hand while the other lays the turns side by side
instruction: Wind the green hose onto the reel neatly, then let go.
context: Groundskeepers "Water lawns, trees, or plants, using portable sprinkler systems, hoses, or watering cans." (O*NET 37-3011.00). A crank hose reel's manual (Yardworks 059-0819-6) says: "Distribute the hose evenly over the surface of the drum assembly." A hose reel maker's support page: "Use the crank handle to wind the hose into the box evenly." Done by hand, one hand turns the crank while the other feeds the hose across the drum.
setup: Station table, cm from the midpoint between the arm bases (x forward, y left). Reel: grey PVC drum 6 cm dia x 14 cm (y 7-21), red 12 cm dia x 6 mm flanges, axle along y at x 34, 7.5 cm up, on two dark 16 x 6 mm uprights; dark crank arm at y 4.7 through the axle, 20 g counterweight on one end, 2.4 cm black ball handle on a pin on an 8.4 cm stem at the other, 5 cm from the axle at y -5, starting straight up. Green 10 mm PVC hose, 60 cm, 60 g, end clamped to the drum bottom at y 7.8; it runs 16 cm toward the robot, bends left (10 cm radius) and runs back out to a black 40 x 16 x 16 mm nozzle at x 31.9, y 27.8. A pawl on the axle lets the drum turn freely to wind but not back.
scoring: Score 0 if: the drum turns forward over 0.3 rad in all (past its furthest point since the handle was last gripped) while the handle is not gripped; at the end a gripper is within 3 cm of hose, nozzle or handle; or the reel, judged 1 s after the last let-go, is not neat: wound part over 4 mm above the first layer, a turn not 8-17 mm across the drum from the last (always the same way), or hose loose between the flanges (last 2 cm off the drum exempt). Wound = most hose on the drum while a hand was near (3 cm), less sag past 6 cm. 0.3: 36-41 cm; 0.6: 42-47 cm; 1.0: 48 cm+ (all but 12 of 60).
reset_notes: Lift the pawl, unwind the reel by its handle until the handle is straight up, lay the hose in the U shown (16 cm straight off the drum bottom toward the robot, 10 cm radius bend to the left, back out to the nozzle at x 31.9, y 27.8). Nothing is randomised.
fidelity: The 10 mm hose is 2 cm rigid segments with bending springs, no twist, no water; a scaled reel (60 cm, about 2 turns). Wound hose takes the drum's curve (coil set) so it cannot spring the drum back. The handle turns on a pin. The drum has axle drag, 0.005 N m friction and a one-way pawl (stiff catch against unwinding, slips above 0.15 N m). A gripper squeezing the hose stalls the crank. Let go, the slack wound end slowly sags off, so the reel is judged 1 s after release.
